'''Roving MSGR Jacket''' is a {{gear|3|Armor}}gear item.

{{Item description|Designed by Endfield after referencing wildland handcrafting techniques, and assembled by the AIC. This equipment improves the wearer's combat capabilities.|A jacket that any messenger would love to wear. 
Messengers working in and near the Valley IV region will often give their vehicles paintjobs with tree-like patterns. They hope the sight of these majestic plants that once protected this land can bring people strength.}}
